cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede that one ball was out. Keep the match. I taught you to watch where it lands, not who hit it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does it matter if I still win?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're separating two things at last. The ball landed beyond the line; I'd like you to call that accurately even with the trophy in your hand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not asking for a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Say 'out', the way we practised calling a line. Then take your trophy home; I won't make you play for it again.
